content: Case study consensus (Scrimba, Profy.dev 60+ hiring-manager survey 2021, several career blogs): structure Problem -> Role -> Approach/Decisions -> Challenges -> Result -> What I'd do differently; outcome and role stated in first 100 words; 200-500 words per project is a rough heuristic; reviewers spend seconds to ~3 minutes; 3-5 projects, case studies for top 2-3; live link + code link expected; 93% would look at a portfolio site, 51% say no penalty for lacking one; metrics must tie to business value, vague claims read as filler; red flags: skill bars, tutorial clones, broken demos, heavy animation, no mobile, stale content, missing write-ups.
